items.title: HPE CEO's advice to employees: Major in your job, minor in AI
items.summary: HPE President & CEO Antonio Neri explains why "culture is everything" when it comes to retaining talent, and shares his advice on how anyone in the workforce can take advantage of the new opportunities AI will create, even as it reduces some jobs.

items.title: Inside the HPE cooling lab solving AI's power problem
items.summary: CEO Antonio Neri showcases the water-cooled supercomputer lab where HPE is tackling the heat and energy demands of AI by developing systems that use less space and less energy, explaining why sustainability requires the whole infrastructure, not just the chips, to keep up.

items.title: HPE CEO Antonio Neri is building the machines behind the AI boom
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE: HPE) President & CEO Antonio Neri shows host Ryan Patel around the company's Houston campus, from its supercomputer labs to its beekeeping project, showcasing how HPE is building the AI infrastructure powering the future, from missions to the moon to next-gen cooling tech.

items.title: HPE Adds Former JPMorgan Exec to Board, Amends Agreement With Elliott Investment
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise amended its cooperation agreement with Elliott Investment Management to allow it to add Jennifer Nason to the board.

items.title: AI agent swarms could turn major outages into identity risks: Anthropic investor
items.summary:
Deirdre Bosa sits down with IVP General Partner Somesh Dash to discuss how evolving AI agents could turn outages into heightened identity risks.

IVP is an investor in Anthropic (ANTH.PVT), which is set to go public via a mega-IPO this Thursday.
